heading: Rules and regulations
lead: The Secretary of Labor shall prescribe rules and regulations for the enforcement of sections 9 and 9a of this title.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: This section and sections 9 and 9a of this title comprised sections 1 to 3 of act Apr. 13, 1934, which were to terminate one year after Apr. 13, 1934, pursuant to section 4 of act Apr. 13, 1934, set out as a Codification note under section 9 of this title. Such sections were temporarily extended by acts Apr. 11, 1935, and June 15, 1937, and were made permanent by act Apr. 15, 1939.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1946—Act Aug. 7, 1946, repealed provisions requiring Secretary of the Interior to make annual reports to Congress.
